title: Daniel's Vision of Four Beasts
hint: Parallel to the statue in chapter 2
intro: Daniel saw four great beasts coming up from the sea. This vision expands on the dream of the statue and reveals the same four world empires from another perspective.

items.title: Lion with Eagle's Wings
items.text: The first was like a lion with eagle's wings. The wings were torn off; it was lifted up and given a human heart. Babylon.

items.title: Bear
items.text: The second beast looked like a bear. It was raised up on one side and had three ribs in its mouth. Media-Persia.

items.title: Leopard with Four Wings
items.text: The third was like a leopard with four bird's wings on its back and four heads. Greece (four successor kingdoms).

items.title: Terrifying Beast
items.text: The fourth beast was dreadful and terrifying, with great iron teeth. It had ten horns. The Roman Empire.

items.title: The Little Horn
items.text: Among the horns a little horn came up. Three horns were plucked out by the roots. The horn had eyes and a mouth that spoke great things.

items.title: The Ancient of Days
items.text: The Ancient of Days took his seat. His clothing was white as snow, and the hair of his head like pure wool. His throne was flaming fire. Judgment was set.

items.title: The Son of Man
items.text: With the clouds of heaven came one like a son of man. He was given dominion, glory, and a kingdom—an everlasting dominion.
